source_notes: Official PMMSY fishing harbour list used for state assignment and harbour count.
Environmental values remain deterministic synthetic demo baselines; they are not live observations.
Canonical display names normalize common place-name variants while sourceName preserves source wording.
No candidate location records were invented; 27 malformed control-character IDs were repaired by removing the form-feed character and matched to existing location IDs.

issues.issue: 27 candidate location IDs contained a leading form-feed control character
issues.action: stripped control character and revalidated against 7,935 location IDs

issues.issue: 66 PMMSY fishing-harbour records had missing state metadata
issues.action: assigned state using official PMMSY harbour list ordering/state grouping; source district/name retained

issues.issue: facility environment state values were JSON NaN/missing
pfzPotentialScore and fishingPotential are derived/synthetic prototype indicators and may be correlated
issues.action: do not double-count them as independent evidence; define productivity engine explicitly

issues.issue: environmental values are synthetic demo baselines
issues.action: never label them as live observations or current INCOIS/IMD measurements

issues.issue: ports are a researched subset, not a complete national port inventory
